_about: BabyKalki shared secret patterns v0.3 (18 Nov 2026; unchanged since v0.2, 17 Nov). ONE list used by library_svc.py, babykalki-diary.mjs and the git pre-commit check (bk_secrets.py). Patterns are for REAL key formats only. Bare hex (git SHAs, SHA-256 sums, R2 key ids) is deliberately NOT a pattern: those are caught by the exact-match check against hashes of your own secret values, or by the key=value rule below.

patterns.name: zai-api-key
patterns.note: Z.ai/Zhipu: 32 hex + '.' + 16 alnum (format per trufflehog issue #4658)

patterns.name: github-token
patterns.note: classic GitHub tokens (36 chars after prefix)

patterns.name: razorpay-key
patterns.note: Razorpay live key id (its secret is caught by key=value or exact match)

assignment._about: key = value / key: value where the KEY names a secret and the VALUE looks like a key (>=16 chars, letters AND digits, no spaces). 'Password = must be rotated quarterly' and 'The GitHub token: expires every 90 days' do NOT match. Values that are environment-variable NAMES (e.g. RCLONE_CONFIG_R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) are skipped.
